faq_heading: Surrey houses with suites: your questions answered

faq.q: How much does a Surrey house with a suite cost?
faq.a: The 132 houses with a legal suite that closed between November 1, 2025 and August 31, 2026 had a median of $1,607,500, with the middle half between $1,400,075 and $1,900,000. Every Surrey detached house had a median of $1,300,500.

faq.q: What is the difference between a legal and an unauthorized suite in Surrey?
faq.a: A legal suite is listed as Legal Suite or Licensed Suite, and an unauthorized one as Unauthorized Suite. 132 Surrey houses sold with a legal suite and 279 with an unauthorized one, which had a median of $1,341,130.

faq.q: How big can a suite be in Surrey?
faq.a: Up to 40% of the principal unit’s habitable floor area, with one suite for each single-family, semi-detached or duplex unit. It can’t be inside a coach house or garden suite.

faq.q: Does a legal suite change a Surrey utility bill?
faq.a: Yes. In 2026 a legal secondary suite adds $454.00 for water, $821.71 for sewer and $172.04 for garbage. A house without one pays flat rates of $1,195 for water and $1,661 for sewer.

faq.q: Which Surrey neighbourhoods have the most houses with legal suites?
faq.a: Sullivan Station had 20 legal-suite sales, Fleetwood Tynehead 19 and East Newton 18 between November 1, 2025 and August 31, 2026.

faq.q: How fast do Surrey houses with a legal suite sell?
faq.a: 32 days at a median, closing at 96.4% of list, with 9% over the list price.

This search lists detached houses for sale in Surrey and North Surrey that have a suite, legal or marked unauthorized. The busiest areas by house sales were Fleetwood Tynehead (113), West Newton (81), Fraser Heights (76), East Newton (75) and Bear Creek Green Timbers (71). Condos, townhomes and half duplexes are separate searches.

Of 785 detached houses that closed in Surrey between November 1 and August 31, 411 (52%) had a suite: 132 legal and 279 unauthorized. The legal-suite houses sold for a median of $1,607,500, 24% more than the $1,300,500 median for every Surrey house.

blocks.text: Surrey suite rules

Under Surrey’s Zoning Bylaw No. 12000, each single-family, semi-detached or duplex unit may have one secondary suite, and the suite’s habitable floor area cannot pass 40% of the principal unit. A suite is not allowed inside a coach house or garden suite, and it can’t be strata-titled on its own.

A suite built without a permit does not become legal because Surrey changed its zoning in July 2024. The City has said the new rules do not legalize unpermitted suites after the fact, and that is the line between the two columns in the table above.

The same July 2024 rules changed what a lot can hold. A lot under 280 square metres can take 3 units and a larger one 4, and an eligible lot of 281 square metres or more within 400 metres of a frequent bus stop can take as many as 6, so some suite houses are worth comparing as building sites.

The MLS® Home Price Index benchmark for a detached house in Surrey was $1,304,100 in September 2026, 9.0% down over twelve months. In North Surrey it was $1,252,600. The benchmark is the price of a typical house, not a median of sales.
Costs of a Surrey house with a suite

Surrey’s 2026 property tax rate is $3.42731 per $1,000 of assessed value. A legal suite adds $454.00 for water and $821.71 for sewer over the year, $1,275.71 together, and $172.04 for garbage. A house with no suite pays flat rates of $1,195 for water, $1,661 for sewer and $344.08 for waste.
Before you offer on a Surrey house with a suite

items.t: Ask for the Surrey permit and final inspection for the suite. 279 of the 411 suite houses sold here were unauthorized, so the paperwork comes first.
Ask whether the suite is on the City’s utility account. Surrey adds water, sewer and garbage charges for a legal suite.
Measure the suite against the limit of 40% of the principal unit’s habitable area. On the median Surrey legal-suite house of 3,888 square feet, 40% comes to about 1,560 square feet.
If a tenant lives in the suite, ask for the tenancy agreement and the rent; a tenancy usually carries on after a sale. Legal-suite houses took 32 days to sell, so there is time to ask.

If the listing says unauthorized, compare the price with the $1,341,130 median for unauthorized-suite houses and the $1,607,500 median for legal ones, then decide whether to legalize the suite or remove it.
